scope: Exploratory source-fit/source-validation diagnostic only; no new outer-target score, independent confirmation or deployment claim
input: Only existing whole2s,8-30Hz,CAR,trace-normalized,0.05-regularized36dim weighted log covariance; no winning time/frequency branch

mapping.distribution: RBFSampler fixed numeric gamma, float64 dummy1x36 fit; W iid N(0,2gamma), b iid U(0,2pi), seeds42/43/44; maps identical across folds and both augmented methods
mapping.linear_control: zW/sqrt(128), no cosine or offset; same W and164dim coefficient array but still affine in original36features

normalization: Fit StandardScaler only26source people. LINEAR uses z unchanged. Augmented use [z/sqrt(2), (aux-mean_source_aux)*sqrt(18/mean_source_squared_aux_norm)]. Both blocks source mean squared norm18, total36. One source scalar per aux block, not column scaler. No validation-fit normalizer.
budget: 30 existing LINEAR models reused byte-exact; 30folds x2augmented conditions x3fixed maps=180new logistic fits; 210total states frozen together before this round scoring. No gamma/C/dimension/seed grid or validation checkpoint selection.
hypothesis: A fixed restricted nonlinear boundary on the same WHOLE representation improves source validation beyond both original linear and affine reparameterization controls
falsification: Do not nominate if either co-primary source-validation gate fails; cannot infer all nonlinear models ineffective or missing signal information recovered
aggregation: Each person's BA/F1 first average validation appearances for each seed; then average all3seeds, then equal mean28people. Baseline one deterministic state, not best seed or prediction ensemble. 90person appearances per seed;14and28 absent. Individual seeds descriptive only.

bootstrap.limitation: Repeated source-validation development and overlapping training sets; intervals descriptive, Bonferroni nominal coverage not independent confirmation

source_fit_metrics: Predeclared descriptive mean of26source-person BA per state, then seed/fold average; not external generalization, no model selection
bad_trial_policy: Keep6080trials/515originalauthorflags; all5680source-validation unique trials and510flags retained; no dropping difficult people or trials

verification.independent: Schur logm36dim all6080waves; independently regenerated RandomState maps; complex exp real-part and einsum projection; independently source-normalized mappings; trust-exact plus previously predeclared Newton residual refinement; gradient infinity norm<=1e-6
